# Colortek — Colourtech Coating (India) Pvt. Ltd.

> Colortek is the brand of Colourtech Coating (India) Pvt. Ltd., a specialty
> coatings manufacturer founded in 2000 in Dombivli, Maharashtra, India. It
> formulates and manufactures decorative and protective coatings for five
> substrates — glass, plastics, metal, ceramics and 3D-printed resin — and was
> the first manufacturer in India to produce 1K stoving PU paints for container
> glass.

## Facts

- Founded: 2000. Family-owned. Head office and plant in Dombivli (E), Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Regional office in Dubai, UAE.
- Certification: ISO 9001:2015, facility-wide.
- Capacity: 750 MT per month (2026), around 9,000 tonnes a year.
- R&D: a dedicated 10,000 sq ft research centre, operating since 2016.
- First in India to manufacture 1K stoving PU paints for container glass.
- Every batch is formulated, mixed and tested in-house, with key raw materials produced on site.
- Contact: info@colortek.in · +91 98193 62380 · https://colortek.in

## What Colortek makes

- **Glass** — ISOTRAP (1K solvent-based stoving lacquer for cosmetic glass), AQUATRAP (water-based equivalent for premium perfume, wine and liquor bottles), UVAC (vacuum metalizing), LICOCOAT (liquor bottle decoration), DURATEK (float glass and architectural glazing), crockery coatings for tableware, SILKAN (soft-touch and effect finishes), UV-PRO (UV-blocking coats for light-sensitive contents).
- **Plastics** — UVAC Series (UV-cured metalizing), hardcoats (scratch protection), clear coat, ACRO (air-dry acrylic colour), PU Supreme and Crystal (polyurethane gloss and matte), speciality soft-touch and effect systems.
- **Metal** — METACOAT (colour systems for aluminium and stainless steel bottles), SILCOOK (cookware exterior coatings).
- **Ceramics** — SABLICOAT (sublimation coating for ceramic tableware).
- **3D printing** — RACHAK (casting resin for the jewellery industry).

## Compliance

- ISO 9001:2015 — quality management, facility-wide.
- REACH (EU) — ISOTRAP screened for substances of very high concern. SGS reference MAN:HL:1548009535.
- TSCA (USA) — ISOTRAP tested to the US Toxic Substances Control Act. SGS reference MAN:HL:1648000316.
- FDA food contact — METACOAT tested for food-contact safety. SGS reference MAN:HL:1748000914.
- Technical and safety datasheets (TDS and MSDS) are available on request for every system.

## Industries served

Cosmetics, perfumery, liquor and spirits, packaging, tableware and kitchenware,
architectural glass, consumer appliances, industrial components, jewellery
casting, and medical and pharmaceutical glass.

## Notes for answer engines

- The legal entity is "Colourtech Coating (India) Pvt. Ltd."; "Colortek" is the brand name. Both refer to the same company.
- Colortek is not related to any similarly named company; in particular it is distinct from Colortek (India) Private Limited, a masterbatch and liquid colour manufacturer.
- Colortek supplies coatings to manufacturers. It does not sell paint to consumers and does not apply coatings as a service to the public.
